description: [$0.03] Rank cross-chain DeFi liquidity pools with TVL >= $5M by risk-adjusted real base APY, impermanent loss exposure, and strategic allocation advice. Do not use for cross-chain swap arbitrage (use defi_cross_arb_plan) or wallet borrow health (use defi_position_shield). `chain` defaults to `'base'` (pass `'all'` to scan all supported chains at `$5M+` TVL), and expiring `timeout_ms` returns `degraded=true` with deterministic rankings only. Live DeFiLlama data, read-only; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 20 req/min.

session_token.description: Optional prepaid session token (x402s_...) from https://apix402data.com/pay after the 10-call free preview.

timeout_ms.description: Optional deadline in ms. If the local LLM would exceed it, the response comes back fast with "degraded": true and non-LLM/cached data
